- Removed the match victory and death limit challenges. Challenges can now be completed before the match ends.
- Active versions of those challenges are replaced on startup, including on existing Bingo boards.

Download **CS2Tasks.exe** from **Assets**. Close the app from the system tray before replacing the executable.
